description: Source code for the FileStream::Context class handling asynchronous file operations in the Chromium net namespace.

classes.name: FileStream::Context
classes.description: Handles asynchronous file operations such as open, close, seek, get info, and flush within the Chromium net namespace.

classes.name: FileStream::Context::IOResult
classes.description: Represents the result of IO operations, including success or error codes.

classes.name: FileStream::Context::OpenResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of an open operation, including the file handle and error code.

methods.name: CallInt64ToInt
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer result to a 32-bit integer and runs the callback.

methods.name: FileStream::Context::Open
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous opening of a file with specified flags.

methods.name: FileStream::Context::Close
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous closing of the file.

methods.name: FileStream::Context::Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified offset within the file asynchronously.

methods.name: FileStream::Context::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file is currently open.

methods.name: FileStream::Context::OpenFileImpl
methods.description: Performs the actual file open operation, handling platform-specific details.

methods.description: Performs the actual retrieval of file info.

methods.name: FileStream::Context::CloseFileImpl
methods.description: Performs the actual file close operation.

methods.name: FileStream::Context::FlushFileImpl
methods.description: Performs the actual file flush operation.

methods.name: FileStream::Context::OnOpenCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of the open operation.
